judgment.notes: N005 is used on mean-zero L2 inputs and H1 products exactly within its stated domains. A001 instantiates E006 without changing the timestep, datum, update, normalization or remainder. Routine continuity and smooth Fourier operations are justified in BG001–BG004.

S001 gives continuous polynomial expressions at each fixed positive tau, with real and mean-zero outputs and preservation of smoothness. S002 is the exact E006 conclusion. In S003, the left endpoint integrals vanish; at the right endpoint Q cancels Q(a+tau) in W, leaving f+Fstage+Cst-Rem. With f=v^n this equals v^(n+1). Smooth finite pieces match and concatenate. No tau-to-zero limit or extension of E006 to nonsmooth data is claimed or used.
